nodes.name: Webhook — HubSpot Form Submit
nodes.notes: Triggered by a HubSpot workflow on demo-form submission. Payload includes contactId, email, company, form_responses.

nodes.name: Respond 202 Accepted
nodes.notes: Acknowledge HubSpot immediately so the form submission isn't blocked on the rest of the flow.

nodes.name: Apollo — Enrich Domain
nodes.notes: 8s timeout. neverError so a failed enrichment doesn't kill the flow — score-by-rule fallback handles it downstream.

nodes.name: Claude — Score Lead
nodes.notes: 6s timeout. neverError → empty response triggers the rule-based fallback in Parse Score.

nodes.name: Sheets — Territory Lookup
nodes.notes: Sheet columns: country, sdr_email, sdr_slack_handle, ae_email, ae_slack_handle. Falls back to a 'default' row if no match.

additionalFields.subject: =Inbound demo request — {{ $('Parse Score (with fallback)').item.json.company }} (score {{ $('Parse Score (with fallback)').item.json.score }})

parameters.subject: Thanks for the demo request — a few resources while we review
parameters.html:
=

Hi {{ $('Parse Score (with fallback)').item.json.firstName || 'there' }},

Thanks for getting in touch. While our team reviews your request, here are the resources most teams find useful before a first call:

  • Self-serve product tour (8 min)
  • Pricing and editions
  • Case studies by industry

If you'd like to skip ahead, you can start a free trial in under two minutes.

— The team

nodes.name: Email — Self-serve Nurture (low)
nodes.notes: Low-score leads get an automated nurture, not a dead end. Subsequent product activation re-triggers the flow.

nodes.name: Nightly Backstop Cron
nodes.notes: Catches any contact whose webhook silently failed in the last 24h. Set timezone in workflow Settings.

nodes.name: HubSpot — Find Missed Submissions
nodes.notes: Looks for any subscriber-stage contact with a recent_conversion in last 26h that has no icp_score__c. These are leads the webhook missed.
